name: xlholdout6c
selection_method: Metadata-only Gate 1 screening holdout selected from committed XL100 by the XLHoldout6b rule. Exclude every source document used by XL10, XLDev24, XLHoldout6, or XLHoldout6b (28 documents). Keep answerable single-document questions only. Reject every question whose pinned source is recorded as a PDF preflight failure in data/cache/xl-docbench/failures.jsonl or data/cache/xl-docbench/documents/failures.jsonl. Within each domain choose the candidate with the lowest source page count, then the lowest source byte size, breaking ties on ascending SHA-256('20260922:' + question_id); the technical_engineering pick used that tie-break. Documented deviation from XLHoldout6b: the affirmative fetch-and-SHA-256 preflight could not be run because selection was performed offline, so only doc_000067 is cache-verified and the remaining five sources are preflight-deferred. Pre-registered contingency, frozen with this file: if a pinned source fails preflight before the Gate 1 run, substitute the next candidate in the same domain's deterministic order and record the substitution in the research log. IDs are explicit, no retrieval or generation result was produced or inspected, and the subset must not be run or tuned on before Gate 1.
